brand.name: Apoyo Food
brand.tagline: Food made by independent creators in Trinidad & Tobago.

footer.legal: Apoyo Food is part of the Apoyo ecosystem. Cooks keep their own kitchens, prices and customers.

comingSoon.phaseNote: Planned for phase {phase} of the build.

becomeSeller.title: Cook and sell on Apoyo Food
becomeSeller.description: Home cooks, bakers and caterers will be able to set up a kitchen here — profile, service areas, languages, menu and photos — and start taking orders. Registration opens once seller onboarding is built, so nobody signs up for a form that cannot be finished.

requestOrder.title: Requesting an order
requestOrder.description: You will pick items and quantities, choose pickup, delivery or a meet-up, and propose a date and time that fits the cook's availability. Nothing is charged here: the cook confirms first, and payment happens between the two of you.

buyerOrders.title: Your orders
buyerOrders.description: Every request you make will live here with its status — waiting on the cook, accepted, ready, completed — along with the agreed price and the conversation thread for the details.

messageSeller.title: Talking to a cook
messageSeller.description: Messaging is built into an order rather than sitting on a profile, and it translates itself between English and Spanish. That is on purpose: it keeps pickup addresses and phone numbers out of public pages and inside a conversation that only starts once a cook has accepted your request.

buyerAccount.title: Your account
buyerAccount.description: Saved addresses, your language, notification settings and your Apoyo profile will live here. You can browse the whole marketplace without an account — you are only asked to sign in when you commit to something.

filters.title: Filter meals
filters.description: Narrow the list down. Your choices apply when you tap Show results.

translation.heading: Order-thread translation
translation.note: Computed once at send time and stored on the message — never recomputed on read. If the translate service is down, the original is delivered unchanged.
translation.serviceDown: Translate service unreachable when this was written — showing the original, which is the intended degrade, not an error.

styleGuide.title: Sobremesa components
styleGuide.intro: Every primitive from the component library, rendered against dummy data. This page is a build tool, not a storefront page — it is deliberately unlinked, and it is what scripts/verify-a11y.mjs drives at two widths in both locales.

notes.everyStub: Every key in lib/coming-soon.ts, rendered. Each trigger stamps data-coming-soon on itself so a later audit can check the stub inventory against a rendered page.
notes.media: The photos below are synthetic, but they are pushed through the real Slice 4 ingest pipeline — variants, EXIF strip and blur placeholder — and served by the real storage driver, so the blur-up is the production path rather than a mock.
notes.availability: Part F3 asks for ink on a -vivid fill. Only gold-vivid clears AA at this size (6.55:1); green-vivid measures 3.10, terracotta-vivid 3.64, teal-vivid 3.80. Stamps therefore use the text-safe accent — a cream label on the accent fill (5.44-5.72:1), or the accent on its own soft tint for the large market stamp (4.52-4.72:1).
notes.freshToday: Rounded-rectangular cards, never circular rings. Teal freshness dot, the availability window on the card, and seen/unseen as a border treatment.
notes.skeletons: Never a spinner on a browse surface — skeletons plus blur-up only.
notes.rail: Snap-scrolling, full-bleed on mobile, and focusable so it is reachable without gestures.

home.title: Discover
home.intro: Home cooks, bakers, dessert makers and caterers near you — meals by pre-order, weekend specials, party trays and holiday menus.

browse.title: Browse
browse.resultsFiltered: {count, plural, =0 {No meals match} one {# meal matches} other {# meals match}} your filters
browse.emptyBody: Try widening the area or the price, or clear a filter. Every search that finds nothing is recorded — it is how cooks learn what people near them are looking for.

sellers.title: Cooks
sellers.emptyTitle: No cooks in that area yet
sellers.emptyBody: Pick another area on the map, or browse everyone.

category.title: Category
category.emptyBody: No cook has listed anything in this category near you. Try another category.

meal.title: Meal
meal.body: The full listing — gallery, availability, seller card and the Request order CTA — arrives in Slice 10.

sellerProfile.title: Seller profile
sellerProfile.body: Cover, bio, areas, Menu shelf and Follow arrive in Slice 11.

search.title: Search
search.label: Search meals and cooks
search.prompt: Search by dish, ingredient or cook.
search.emptyBody: Nobody nearby is listing that yet. We record every search that finds nothing — it is exactly how cooks discover what people around them want.

saved.title: Saved
saved.body: Saved meals arrive in Slice 10; named collections in Phase 4.

orders.title: My orders
orders.body: Order history and the order thread arrive in Slices 17 and 18.

account.title: Account
account.body: Account settings arrive with the shared identity wiring in Slice 3.

login.title: Sign in
login.body: Sign-in posts to the central issuer (portal-web) — wired in Slice 3. Browsing never requires an account; you are only asked to sign in when you commit to something.

register.title: Create an account
register.body: Registration posts to the central issuer (portal-web) — wired in Slice 3.

sections.freshTodayNote: What cooks near you have going right now.
sections.availableSoonNote: Computed from each listing's availability windows, in Trinidad time.
sections.trendingNote: What people have been looking at over the last two weeks.
sections.nearYouNote: Pick your area on the cook directory and it follows you around the site.
sections.seasonalNote: Holiday menus and seasonal specials, shown only while they are actually open.

dashboard.title: Seller dashboard
dashboard.body: Your order inbox, listings, Fresh Today posts and profile will live here. Onboarding arrives in Slice 13, listings in Slice 14, Fresh Today tools in Slice 15.

admin.title: Food administration
admin.body: The seller approval queue, listing takedowns, report intake and the category manager arrive in Slice 16, composed into the shared Apoyo admin shell.

login.title: Seller sign-in
login.body: Sellers sign in with the same ecosystem account — wired in Slice 3.

scaffold.heading: Slice 1 scaffold
scaffold.note: This page and the token proof below are scaffolding with a scheduled death — Slice 7 deletes both when the real Sobremesa component library lands.
scaffold.vividNote: Ink on green/teal/terracotta-vivid measures 3.10–3.80:1 — large or bold text and icons only. gold-vivid (6.55:1) is safe at any size, which is why it carries the status chips.
